item.title: Youtuber MrBeast buys youth-focused fintech app
item.description: Beast Industries, owned by the YouTube star known as MrBeast, has acquired the Gen Z-oriented financial wellness app Step.

item.title: Fiserv looks to AI, BNPL to spur its recovery
item.description: Following a massive earnings miss three months ago, the bank-technology seller on Tuesday reported signs of stability and an embrace of new payments and financial services technology.

item.title: Regional bank execs love mobile apps, fear wire transfer fraud
item.description: Top takeaways from American Banker's 2026 Predictions report finds that midsize bankers push for app investments and are concerned about wire transfer fraud.

item.title: Souring card debt is plateauing at elevated level: New York Fed
item.description: Delinquencies on credit-card debt mostly held steady at the end of last year, but certain groups of consumers are faring better than others.

item.title: D.C. appeals court hands favorable ruling to EWA fintech EarnIn
item.description: The district's appeals court let stand a May 2025 ruling that dismissed most of the D.C. Attorney General's claims against EarnIn in a major win for the firm and good news for fintechs looking for favorable regulatory treatment.

item.title: Ethereum becomes rail of choice for crypto-curious bankers
item.description: JPMorganChase, Citi and Custodia are among the banks that have built digital asset projects on the Ethereum blockchain.

item.title: Developer Colony Ridge to pay $68M in DOJ, Texas settlement
item.description: Houston developer Colony Ridge Development agreed to resolve allegations that it operated a bait-and-switch scheme targeting Hispanic immigrants that led to massive foreclosures.

item.title: Huntington takes $280M hit on Cadence deal accounting
item.description: The Ohio bank said its 2027 earnings per share will be lower due to an accounting revision linked to its acquisition of Cadence Bank. But CEO Steve Steinour remains sold on Huntington's expansion plans, calling the Cadence deal a "home run transaction."

item.title: Brazil fintech Agibank scales back IPO before US debut
item.description: The digital bank slashed its share volume and pricing the day before its public debut and following a mixed U.S. public debut for fellow Brazil fintech PicPay.

item.title: Bank riders have murky future as housing bill heads to Senate
item.description: Bank-favored provisions that were included into the House's version of a bipartisan housing bill threaten to derail Senate passage, but Senate Banking Committee moderates seem skeptical of the combination.
